text: Implemented ADR 007 plus typed HopDistance, unordered endpoint identity, graph-scoped witnesses, durable/ephemeral recipe identity, and independent Floyd-Warshall reference decomposition. Verified 28 standard tests on JVM, Scala.js, and Scala Native; new suite exhaustively covers simple graphs through four vertices plus collision, reindexing, multiplicity, disconnection, and fused/reference laws.
